instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Once she is flying fast enough, she can open the parachute and safely glide to the ground.
atoms.b: Once she is flying fast enough, she can open the ((parachute)) and safely glide to the ground.

atoms.a: Luckily, the operation was successful and paralysis could be prevented.
atoms.b: Luckily, the operation was successful and ((paralysis)) could be prevented.

atoms.a: After long and heated discussions, the parliament eventually voted on the bill.
atoms.b: After long and heated discussions, the ((parliament)) eventually voted on the bill.

atoms.a: How did you persuade your brother to bring out the rubbish?
atoms.b: How did you ((persuade)) your brother to bring out the rubbish?

atoms.a: The persistent noise from outside hindered Frankie’s sleep.
atoms.b: The ((persistent)) noise from outside hindered Frankie’s sleep.

atoms.a: Fortunately, people perceive beauty very differently. Otherwise, a lot would look the same.
atoms.b: Fortunately, people ((perceive)) beauty very differently. Otherwise, a lot would look the same.
